topic: Nagato uses Rinne Rebirth to bring back the people his attack took from Konoha, at the cost of his own life
title: Naruto's Pain Undid His Own Lesson
description: Pain built his whole plan on the idea that suffering teaches peace. Then Nagato used Rinne Rebirth to bring back the people his attack took from Konoha. Was that a confession that Pain was wrong, or proof his heart was about peace all along?
comment: Did Nagato's last act prove Pain was wrong, or that his heart was always about peace? Pick one.

lines.text: Pain spent his whole plan teaching the world that peace costs suffering.

shot.fallback: six pale figures standing in a dark field

lines.text: Then Nagato used his last strength to undo the lesson.

shot.fallback: glowing light rising over a ruined village

lines.text: Rinne Rebirth brings back the people his attack took from Konoha.

shot.fallback: spirits rising around a ninja in glowing light

lines.text: And it costs him his own life.

shot.fallback: ninja standing in light as dawn breaks

lines.text: Here's my read on what that says about his heart.

shot.fallback: thoughtful ninja with a grave expression

lines.text: Pain believed suffering was the teacher.

shot.fallback: pale ninja with rinnegan eyes in dim light

lines.text: But that teacher never gave him a reason to choose peace.

shot.fallback: villagers standing in a broken street

lines.text: Naruto did, and he did it with a conversation instead of a punch.

shot.fallback: two ninja talking quietly in the rain

lines.text: Pain's bet was that people only learn from loss.

shot.fallback: pale leader standing in heavy rain

lines.text: Naruto's bet is that people can learn from each other.

shot.fallback: young ninja smiling in morning light

lines.text: So which bet did Nagato finally choose with his last breath?

shot.fallback: two ninja facing each other at dusk

lines.text: A plan built on suffering can only end with someone choosing to undo it.

shot.fallback: young ninja in orange jacket walking forward

self_check.hook: Line 1 names Pain and the suffering-teaches-peace claim.
self_check.loop: The last line leads into the first line's plan.
